scientific_integrity: Exact combinatorial expansion and self-contained critical-window cumulant proof; 16 complete finite rational enumeration cases corroborate finite algebra. These computations do not establish infinite-dimensional limits.
scientific_limitations: Independent, identically biased edge orientations relative to a fixed order; off-window p_n is bounded away from zero and one; no local limit, joint motif limit or explicit convergence rate. Historical priority of the crossover not independently established.
title: A Gaussian critical window for directed triangles in noisy ordered tournaments
